prose: A Wall Street Journal report that Mark Carney, Emmanuel Macron and other Western leaders are pushing to establish a global supervisory body for AI - coordinated through what the piece calls a leaders' group chat. The body is paywalled and was not captured, so this summary rests on the headline.

On that basis: after national frameworks and voluntary commitments, heads of government are attempting top-down international AI coordination - with the usual questions of who joins, who enforces, and whether the US and China sit at the table. Detail is unknown from the capture.
highlights: WSJ: Carney, Macron and other leaders pushing a global AI supervisory body
Coordination happening at head-of-government level - 'the group chat'
Would be the first attempt at standing international AI governance with executive backing
Paywalled; membership, mandate and enforcement unknown
